title: Accountability Before God
definition: Accountability before God means every person is responsible to God for their life, actions, words, motives, and response to Christ.
summary: No one is hidden from God. His judgment is righteous, and His mercy in Christ is the only safe refuge.
christFocus: Christ calls people to repentance, faith, and faithful living because all will stand before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: No one is hidden from God. His judgment is righteous, and His mercy in Christ is the only safe refuge.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
